import base64
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

script = runpy.run_path('tests/smoke/emulator-plugin-market.py')
support = script['support']
agent = script['agent']
root = Path('.build/plugin-market')
e = support['Emulator']('127.0.0.1:15557', 19644)
forward = ('tcp:19644', 'tcp:19592')
e.hdc('fport', *forward)
try:
    e.ready('normal')
    audit = {'boot':e.state(), 'anonymousHttp':e.web_status(False), 'authenticatedHttp':e.web_status(True),
             'defaultPermissionPreset':e.rpc('permissionPresets/catalog',{})['defaultPreset'],
             'testCredentialAbsent':not e.rpc('credentials/describe',{'refs':['DEEPSEEK_API_KEY']})['DEEPSEEK_API_KEY']['configured']}
    assert audit['boot'] == {'mode':'normal','pending':False}
    assert (audit['anonymousHttp'],audit['authenticatedHttp']) == (401,200)
    assert audit['defaultPermissionPreset'] == 'workspace-write' and audit['testCredentialAbsent']
    assert e.app('test ! -e ' + 'alpine/native-benchmark-home/cordis.patch.yml' + ' && printf ABSENT') == 'ABSENT'
    audit['homePatchAbsent'] = True
    profile = script['PROFILE']
    digests = {name:hashlib.sha256(agent['read_bytes'](e,profile+'/'+name)).hexdigest() for name in ['package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml']}
    assert digests == {'package.json':'c5955d33c12dce37f48bbd9f6319bbb6288b19ab49af22898aa337403b4608b8',
                       'pnpm-lock.yaml':'3e17f9c545e2c97679668286cedc0e0907159ee38a2b457569802b8a320b913e'}
    audit['profileHashes'] = digests
    audit['catalogRestoredToDisabled'] = script['market'](e, False)
    titles_badge = runpy.run_path('tests/smoke/emulator-titles-badge.py')
    audit['priorTitleAndBadgeBundlesStillOfferedAndDisabled'] = titles_badge['catalog'](e, False)
    titles_badge['assert_providers'](e, False)
    prior_catalog = runpy.run_path('tests/smoke/emulator-worktree-restore.py')
    audit['priorFourOptionalBundlesStillOfferedAndDisabled'] = prior_catalog['catalog_state'](e, set())
    rows = support['events'](e,'session-ecf0df3c-47a9-4df4-b71e-6d4261d13419')
    assert len(rows)==30
    audit['oldRc3SessionEventCount'] = len(rows)
    fixture = json.loads((root/'plugin-market-0.4.41.json').read_text())['fixture']
    assert e.app('test ! -e alpine/workspace-native/'+fixture+' && printf ABSENT') == 'ABSENT'
    assert script['catalog'](e, fixture) is None
    assert e.app('test ! -e '+script['origin_path'](fixture)+' && printf ABSENT') == 'ABSENT'
    assert 'tcp:19742 ' not in e.hdc('fport','ls')
    audit['fixtureAbsent'] = True
    digest = hashlib.sha256(agent['read_bytes'](e, profile+'/cordis.patch.yml')).hexdigest()
    assert digest == '36dc6d7818b81638e19ec84b2d83a2f4acbd70a45bfcd9dc8c00b67a39161060'
    audit['profilePatchSha256'] = digest
    chat = runpy.run_path('tests/smoke/emulator-chat-import.py')
    audit['priorChatImportStillOfferedAndDisabled'] = chat['bundle'](e, False)
    recorded = json.loads((root/'artifact-0.4.41.json').read_text())
    release = 'alpine/.dsh-0.2.2-rc.4'
    manifest = json.loads(agent['read_bytes'](e,release+'/dsh/package.json'))
    previous = json.loads((root/'artifact.json').read_text())
    assert previous['layerSha256'] == recorded['layerSha256']
    expected = previous['newCarrierDependencies']
    assert expected.items() <= manifest['dependencies'].items()
    audit['marketCarrierDependencies'] = expected
    assert e.app('test -f '+release+'/.validated-unpack-v2-dsh-layer.zip-'+recorded['layerSha256']+' && printf PRESENT') == 'PRESENT'
    audit['installedDshLayerSha256'] = recorded['layerSha256']
    (root/'audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(audit))
finally:
    e.hdc('fport','rm',*forward)
